script.es: Tacos como en la calle, de verdad.

parrafo.es: Manny's Tacos To Go sirve tacos de la calle desde su food truck en Sarasota. Sus clientes en Google vuelven una y otra vez por el sabor autentico y las porciones generosas.
parrafo.en: Manny's Tacos To Go serves authentic street tacos from their food truck in Sarasota. Their Google reviewers keep coming back for the authentic flavor and generous portions.

hero.imagen_alt: Food truck de Manny's Tacos To Go al atardecer con su letrero encendido

parrafo_1.es: Manny's Tacos To Go sirve tacos de la calle desde su truck en Bee Ridge Rd, Sarasota, viernes y sabados por la noche.
parrafo_1.en: Manny's Tacos To Go serves street tacos from their truck on Bee Ridge Rd in Sarasota, Friday and Saturday nights.

parrafo_2.es: Sus clientes en Google destacan tacos recien hechos, porciones generosas por el precio y un sabor que los hace volver semana tras semana.
parrafo_2.en: Their Google reviewers point to freshly made tacos, generous portions for the price and a flavor that brings them back week after week.

texto.es: Vie-Sab de 4 PM a 1 AM en Bee Ridge Rd, Sarasota.
texto.en: Fri-Sat 4 PM to 1 AM on Bee Ridge Rd, Sarasota.

texto.es: Elige tus tacos, todo se prepara al momento.
texto.en: Pick your tacos, everything is made to order.

texto.es: Nada de precocinado, cada taco se arma cuando lo pides.
texto.en: Nothing precooked, every taco is built when you order it.

texto.es: Solo efectivo por ahora, trae cash para evitar demoras.
texto.en: Cash only for now, bring cash to avoid delays.

nota.es: El menu puede variar segun la noche. Llamanos para catering de eventos.
nota.en: The menu can vary by night. Call us for event catering.

texto.es: Tacos autenticos servidos con cilantro, cebolla y salsas de la casa.
texto.en: Authentic tacos served with cilantro, onion and house salsas.

texto.es: Servidos con jalapenos asados para quien le gusta picante de verdad.
texto.en: Served with grilled jalapenos for those who like it really spicy.

texto.es: Porciones generosas para grupos, buen valor por lo que traes.
texto.en: Generous portions for groups, great value for what you get.

titulo.en: To go or eat on site

texto.es: Mesas junto al truck o tu orden lista para llevar.
texto.en: Tables next to the truck, or your order ready to go.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Pregunta en el truck, el menu varia.
pie.en: Do not see what you need? Ask at the truck, the menu varies.

items.quote: This is my favorite place to get authentic tacos! I saw it every weekend and finally decided to give it the ole college try! So this is my third time and honestly it's just as delicious as the first and second.
THESE ARE THE BEST TACOS I HAVE EVER HAD!!! The chicken tacos were fabulous!! This is the best spot for taco lovers. They even come with a slice of lime and two sauces.

texto.es: Llamanos para catering o para confirmar si estamos ahi.
texto.en: Call us for catering or to confirm we are out there.
